title: Iran: Neither war nor Peace, Ukraine’s Lifeline, Starmer: “Just a Scratch”?
summary: In a week where a stalemate appears to have developed after nearly two months of asymmetric conflict between the US and Iran, President Trump’s Truth Social posts have swung between belligerent maximalism and breezy deal-making—one minute suggesting a within-reach deal, and that Iranian forces would personally help their enemy confiscate what he called its…
